# Bundled typography

Source Sans 3 Regular and Semibold, and Source Serif 4 Display Semibold are
unmodified Adobe font binaries, redistributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The full copyright notices and licenses are included beside this file and must
remain in all distributed builds.

- https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/tree/release/TTF
- https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif/tree/release/TTF

Imported September 3, 2026. These embedded files are used directly by the game;
the UI does not require the fonts to be installed on the player's computer.
